sloka: महोदरमहापार्शो हतौ दृष्ट्वा तु राक्षसौ।तस्मिंश्च निहते वीरे विरूपाक्षे महाबले।आविवेश महान् क्रोधो रावणं तं महामृधे ।। ६.१००.१ ।।
transliteration: mahodaramahāpārśo hatau dṛṣṭvā tu rākṣasau।tasmiṁśca nihate vīre virūpākṣe mahābale।āviveśa mahān krodho rāvaṇaṁ taṁ mahāmṛdhe ।। 6.100.1 ।।

translations.english: On seeing Mahodara and Mahaparsva killed in the great war, Virupaksha of extraordinary might also killed, Ravana was highly infuriated and addressed the charioteer in the following words.
